scope: same ELF Linux and ordinary guest workflow
finding: CI previously computed a fresh probe hash after product build instead of reusing the Linux reference digest.
resolution: Freeze probe.sha256 before Linux run; verify it after Linux and again before guest; guest receives that frozen hash.
